name: hei5enbug-agent-setup
description: Portable agent skills for repeatable engineering and documentation workflows.

agent_guard.title: Block built-in subagents
agent_guard.description: Hide the built-in general-purpose, Explore, Plan, and claude agents and deny forked subagents so work goes to the plugin's scout and worker agents.

session_approval.title: One-time session approval
session_approval.description: Approve each covered outward write (git tags, tag pushes, gh release create or edit, and Codex worker access to a directory outside the session folder) once per session; destructive or unverifiable actions always ask.

role_pinning.title: Pin role models
role_pinning.description: Run the scout, worker, sonnet-worker, designer, and reviewer agents on their pinned model and effort, and stop an agent that runs on any other model.

implementation_worker.title: Implementation worker
implementation_worker.description: Route implementation work to codex (Codex on gpt-5.6-luna at xhigh), haiku (the plugin worker on claude-haiku-5-5 at high), or sonnet (the plugin sonnet-worker on claude-sonnet-5-5 at high).

review_model.title: Review model
review_model.description: Model that runs independent validation and skill review roles at xhigh. GPT models run through codex exec and Claude models through claude -p.

language_guard.title: Response language guard
language_guard.description: Block or remind when a reply is not written in the configured response language.

datagrip_guard.title: DataGrip query guard
datagrip_guard.description: Run DataGrip reads without approval with a 60-second PostgreSQL limit; share session approval for non-destructive MCP writes, and ask every time for marked sources or destructive queries.

approval_guard.title: Approval guard
approval_guard.description: Run covered CLI, script, database, and MCP reads without approval; approve non-destructive writes once per session per key, including pre-approval bundles; share mcp:session for MCP writes; ask every time for destructive, sensitive, or unclassified calls; deny secret-printing commands and approval-state edits.
